note: Iceland: EEA and Swiss nationals live and work freely (the eea list). Artists, except musicians employed to perform in restaurants, are exempt from the work permit for up to 90 days per calendar year (taken as 90 within 365), provided the work is notified no later than the day it begins, each time; beyond that, a work permit and residence permit (island.is, the Directorate of Immigration). The Act on Foreigners' Right to Work itself wasn't read, since althingi.is refuses this client.

sources.title: Ísland.is, Short-term residence permit: Rights and obligations
sources.said: The following foreign nationals are exempt from the requirement to obtain a work permit for employment in Iceland for up to 90 days per calendar year: ... Artists, with the exception of musicians employed to perform in restaurants. ... It is necessary to notify the authorities of work carried out under this exemption no later than the same day the work begins, on each occasion.
